title: TV Remote Control Functional Design Meeting
summary: The project team met to establish the functional design of a new TV remote control. Based on marketing research and technical constraints, the group decided against voice-activated control in favor of a minimalist, user-focused design featuring a joystick, a black-and-white LCD screen, and minimal buttons. The remote will also include a locator feature with a beeping speaker and flashing LED activated by a transmitter. Future design work will explore integrating corporate branding and pitching the product directly to TV manufacturers.
topics: Review of previous minutes and requirements
Technical feasibility of joystick and LCD
decisions: Eliminate voice-activated control from the product design due to memory, power, and cost constraints.
Adopt a minimalist, user-focused remote design with a black-and-white LCD screen, a joystick, and only essential buttons.
Assign the left/right joystick movements to channel selection and up/down movements to volume control.
Incorporate a remote locator system consisting of a TV-based transmitter and a remote-based speaker and LED.
Restrict the current design specifications to TV control only, as dictated by the project constraints.

actions.task: Investigate the feasibility and power requirements of the transmitter, speaker, LED locator system, and LCD screen.
Gather consumer feedback on the proposed minimalist, joystick-based remote interface.
